title: Wild AG reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content up into place as it scrolls into view: opacity 0 to 1 and a 40px rise, driven by the scroll itself (CSS view timeline). Give items in a column a step number to stagger them.
notes: CSS only: browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
the range is a fixed 240px of scroll after the element's top enters, so things in the first screen are already in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
name: wild-ag-reveal

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default; p, li, h2… where it replaces one)

props.name: step
props.description: position in a staggered column: 0, 1, 2… each arrives a little later

props.name: rise
props.description: how far it rises, in px
